The Main Skill and Auspice can trigger ⟨Terra Mark⟩, dealing ⟪0⟫ of ATK as AoE Terra Mark DMG.

tpl.s: Throws 6 Rose Vials and 1 Wither Vial, dealing DMG over time 1s after landing. Rose Vial: Deals ⟦0⟧ of ATK as AoE Terra Skill DMG every 0.8s. Wither Vial: Deals ⟦1⟧ of ATK as AoE Terra Skill DMG every 0.8s and also inflicts Wither. builds.d: A build that enhances Auspice to deal rapid damage to single targets.
A build that deals AoE skill damage and triggers combos with Auto Attacks.

l.b: Reduces Auspice Beam's Attack Interval. Each additional Auspice shortens the Attack Interval.
l.s: Reduces Auspice Beam's Attack Interval by ⟦0⟧. Each additional Auspice shortens the Attack Interval by ⟦1⟧.

l.b: Increases the Skill DMG of Springseek Coronis. Casting Main Skill generates additional Auspice. Beams link all Auspice units, dealing DMG over time, and can trigger ⟨Terra Mark⟩.
l.s: Increases the Skill DMG of Springseek Coronis by ⟦0⟧. Casting Jade of Vitality (Main Skill) generates one additional Auspice. Auspice Beams link all Auspice units, dealing ⟦1⟧ of Springseek Coronis's ATK as Terra Skill DMG every 0.6s, and can trigger ⟨Terra Mark⟩.

l.b: Increases the Skill DMG of Springseek Coronis. When Auto Attack bullets pass near or through Auspice beams, the duration of all active Auspice is extended.
l.s: Increases the Skill DMG of Springseek Coronis by ⟦0⟧. When Evergreen Needles (Auto Attack) bullets pass near or through Auspice beams, the duration of all active Auspice is extended by 0.5s (up to ⟦1⟧s per Skill cast).

l.b: Increases Auspice's Skill DMG. Increases DMG additionally based on the number of Auspice on the battlefield.
l.s: Increases Auspice's Skill DMG by ⟦0⟧. Increases DMG additionally based on the number of Auspice on the battlefield, up to ⟦1⟧.

l.b: When Springseek Coronis deals Auto Attack DMG, increases Auspice's Terra DMG.
l.s: When Springseek Coronis deals Auto Attack DMG, increases Auspice's Terra DMG by ⟦0⟧ for 5s, stacking up to 6 times.

l.b: Increases Ammo Capacity. When in Crystallized State, increases Fire Rate and fires crystalline bullets that deal additional DMG on hit. Can trigger ⟨Terra Mark⟩.
l.s: Increases Ammo Capacity by ⟦0⟧. When in Crystallized State, increases Fire Rate by ⟦1⟧ and fires crystalline bullets, dealing an additional ⟦2⟧ of Springseek Coronis's ATK as Terra Auto Attack DMG on hit. Can trigger ⟨Terra Mark⟩.

l.b: When in Crystallized State, continuously generates Rose Pulses: Hitting a target creates Crystalline Ground at the target's location to deal delayed DMG. Can trigger ⟨Terra Mark⟩. When Crystallized Ground receives Springseek Coronis's Auto Attack DMG, it detonates early and deals increased DMG.
l.s: When in Crystallized State, a Rose Pulse is generated every 1.5s: Hitting a target creates Crystalline Ground at the target's location, and deals ⟦0⟧ of Springseek Coronis's ATK as Terra Auto Attack DMG after 2.5s. Can trigger ⟨Terra Mark⟩. When Crystallized Ground receives Springseek Coronis's Auto Attack DMG, it detonates early and deals ⟦1⟧ increased DMG.

l.b: Increases Springseek Coronis's Auto Attack DMG. When in Crystallized State, triggering ⟨Terra Mark⟩ extends the state's duration.
l.s: Increases Springseek Coronis's Auto Attack DMG by ⟦0⟧. When in Crystallized State, triggering ⟨Terra Mark⟩ extends the state's duration by 0.6s (up to 3s total per Skill cast).

l.b: Increases Springseek Coronis's Auto Attack DMG. Increases Auto Attack DMG additionally against distant targets.
l.s: Increases Springseek Coronis's Auto Attack DMG by ⟦0⟧. Increases Auto Attack DMG additionally by ⟦1⟧ against distant targets.

l.b: When Springseek Coronis deals Auto Attack DMG, increases the target's Terra DMG Taken.
l.s: When Springseek Coronis deals Auto Attack DMG, increases the target's Terra DMG Taken by ⟦0⟧ for 5s, stacking up to 6 times.

l.b: Increases Springseek Coronis's Terra DMG. When Auto Attack bullets pass near or through Auspice beams, they gain Penetration and increased Terra DMG.
l.s: Increases Springseek Coronis's Terra DMG by ⟦0⟧. When Evergreen Needles (Auto Attack) bullets pass near or through Auspice beams, they gain Penetration and increased Terra DMG by ⟦1⟧.

l.b: Ultimate can trigger ⟨Terra Mark⟩. Increases ATK on trigger.
l.s: Springseek: Burst of Blaze (Ultimate) can trigger ⟨Terra Mark⟩. When Springseek Coronis triggers the Mark, increases ATK by ⟦0⟧ for 5s, stacking up to 6 times.

l.b: Springseek Coronis can dodge one more time. After dodging, increases Terra DMG.
l.s: Springseek Coronis can dodge one more time. After dodging, increases Terra DMG by ⟦0⟧ for 6s.

l.b: Increases Ultimate's Ultimate DMG against elite or higher-tier targets. Additionally inflicts ⟨Allure⟩ on normal targets, dealing DMG when the effect ends.
l.s: Increases the Ultimate DMG of Springseek: Burst of Blaze (Ultimate) against elite or higher-tier targets by ⟦0⟧. Additionally inflicts ⟨Allure⟩ on normal targets: Lasts 2s, and deals ⟦1⟧ of Springseek Coronis's ATK as Terra Ultimate DMG when the effect ends.

l.b: Increases Springseek Coronis's Ultimate DMG. While the Ultimate is on cooldown or its Energy is not full, increases the ATK of Terra Vanguards and Versatile Trekkers in the squad.
l.s: Increases Springseek Coronis's Ultimate DMG by ⟦0⟧. While the Ultimate is on cooldown or its Energy is not full, increases the ATK of Terra Vanguards and Versatile Trekkers by ⟦1⟧.

l.b: When the Ultimate deals DMG, increases Springseek Coronis's ATK.
l.s: When Springseek: Burst of Blaze (Ultimate) deals DMG, increases Springseek Coronis's ATK by ⟦0⟧ for 20s, stacking up to 6 times.

builds.d: A Support build that instantly detonates Rose Vials, dealing massive damage.
A Support build that generates extra Wither Vials to enhance sustained damage.

l.b: For a short duration after casting Instant Blossom (Support Skill), increases Rose Vials' Skill DMG. When a Rose Vial expires, it deals additional DMG.
l.s: Within 3.5s after casting Instant Blossom (Support Skill), increases Rose Vials' Skill DMG by ⟦0⟧. When a Rose Vial expires, it deals an additional ⟦1⟧ of Springseek Coronis's ATK as AoE Terra Skill DMG.

l.b: For each Terra Trekker on the squad, increases the Skill DMG of Rose Vial. Rose Vial will undergo a Rapid Bloom, instantly triggering all remaining DMG from its duration.
l.s: For each Terra Trekker on the squad, increases the Skill DMG of Rose Vial by ⟦0⟧. Rose Vial will undergo a Rapid Bloom, instantly triggering all remaining DMG from its duration.

l.b: For a short duration after Rose Vial inflicts ⟨Terra Mark: Earth Vein⟩ on the target, triggering ⟨Terra Mark⟩ on the target deals additional DMG.
l.s: For 10s after Rose Vial inflicts ⟨Terra Mark: Earth Vein⟩ on the target, triggering ⟨Terra Mark⟩ on the target deals an additional ⟦0⟧ of Springseek Coronis's ATK as Terra Skill DMG.

l.b: For each Rose Vial on the field, increases Rose Vials' Skill DMG.
l.s: For each Rose Vial on the field, increases the Skill DMG dealt by Rose Vials by ⟦0⟧.

l.b: When Rose Vial inflicts ⟨Terra Mark: Earth Vein⟩, increases the Terra DMG Taken of the target.
l.s: When Rose Vial inflicts ⟨Terra Mark: Earth Vein⟩, increases the Terra DMG Taken of the target by ⟦0⟧ for 10s.

l.b: For each Terra Trekker on the squad, increases the Skill DMG of Wither Vial. Changes the number of Rose Vials and Wither Vials thrown by the Support Skill. The Wither Vial converts adjacent Rose Vials into Wither Vials as well.
l.s: For each Terra Trekker on the squad, increases the Skill DMG of Wither Vial by ⟦0⟧. Instant Blossom (Support Skill) now throws 3 Wither Vials and 4 Rose Vials. The Wither Vial converts adjacent Rose Vials into Wither Vials as well.

l.b: Extends the duration of all Vials.
l.s: Extends the duration of all Vials by ⟦0⟧.

l.b: When Wither Vial applies Wither stack to a target that has not yet reached the max stack limit, it deals DMG. For every current stack of Wither on the target, the Skill DMG upon applying a new stack is increased.
l.s: When Wither Vial applies Wither stack to a target that has not yet reached the max stack limit, it deals ⟦0⟧ of Springseek Coronis's ATK as Terra Skill DMG. For every current stack of Wither on the target, the Skill DMG upon applying a new stack is increased by ⟦1⟧.

l.b: For each Wither Vial on the field, increases Wither Vials' Skill DMG.
l.s: For each Wither Vial on the field, increases Wither Vials' Skill DMG by ⟦0⟧.

l.b: When a Rose Vial or Wither Vial is on the field, increases all Terra Trekkers' ATK.
l.s: When a Rose Vial or Wither Vial is on the field, increases all Terra Trekkers' ATK by ⟦0⟧.

l.b: When all squadmates are Terra Trekkers, each Rose Vial on the field increases the Terra Mark DMG taken by the target when Springseek Coronis deals Skill DMG.
l.s: If all squadmates are Terra Trekkers, when Springseek Coronis deals Skill DMG, each Rose Vial on the field increases the Terra Mark DMG taken by the target by ⟦0⟧ for 3s.

l.b: Increases the ATK of Springseek Coronis.
l.s: Increases the ATK of Springseek Coronis by ⟦0⟧.

l.b: Ultimate can inflict ⟨Terra Mark: Earth Vein⟩. Increases Springseek Coronis's ATK.
l.s: Springseek: Burst of Blaze (Ultimate) can inflict ⟨Terra Mark: Earth Vein⟩. Increases Springseek Coronis's ATK by ⟦0⟧.

l.b: Increases Ultimate's Ultimate DMG against elite or higher-tier targets. Additionally inflicts ⟨Allure⟩ on normal targets, dealing DMG when the effect ends.
l.s: Increases the Ultimate DMG of Springseek: Burst of Blaze (Ultimate) against elite or higher-tier targets by ⟦0⟧. Additionally inflicts ⟨Allure⟩ on normal targets: Lasts 2s, and deals ⟦1⟧ of Springseek Coronis's ATK as Terra Ultimate DMG when the effect ends.

l.b: Increases Springseek Coronis's Ultimate DMG. While the Ultimate is on cooldown or its Energy is not full, increases the ATK of Terra Vanguards and Versatile Trekkers in the squad.
l.s: Increases Springseek Coronis's Ultimate DMG by ⟦0⟧. While the Ultimate is on cooldown or its Energy is not full, increases the ATK of Terra Vanguards and Versatile Trekkers by ⟦1⟧.

l.b: When the Ultimate deals DMG, increases Springseek Coronis's ATK.
l.s: When Springseek: Burst of Blaze (Ultimate) deals DMG, increases Springseek Coronis's ATK by ⟦0⟧ for 20s, stacking up to 6 times.
